title: The Gut Bucket Band and the second line behind the Tuxedo Brass Band
summary: Rene's brother hired an unnamed Gut Bucket Band for street jobs, with players such as Flowers; they marched at the back, behind big bands like the Tuxedo.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You always played with your brother's band in the street, huh?

No, well, I tell you what we had, we had, they used to call it Gut Bucket Band. Mm-hmm. See, we didn't have no no-name band. You see, we just, he would get the job and just hire the band, you see. Well, we had everybody in there. You ever know a fella, Flowers? You ever heard of a fella, Flowers? He used to play band. I believe he played Appetite, too.
I've heard plenty of talk about it, he goes in and out of town, I can never go catch him.

Can't catch him, man. Well, anyhow, he used to play Alto. We used to have them upright Alto at that time, you see. And we used to Morris French, Zebra Norris, some clan there. And then he would hire, you know, hire other fellas, sometimes Chris or anybody else, whatever he could get, see. But they had Gut Bucket Band. Now, any time Black Bender would get a funeral, well, if he couldn't get a parade, he couldn't get us, he'd get somebody else.

But mostly we just called it the Gut Bucket Band. That was the second line, you see. Now, you see, way up in the front when they had them big parades, well, Papa Sellers there, that was the Tuxedo Brass Band. And they had a wonderful band. They played all them marches. But man, we was back there, Tunk, and they used to call that the Tunk back there. And we was just, there were all the second lines there, right back there. Right behind the band, by our band. Sometimes it was better, back, better brass band. Sometimes it was Kid Renny, brass band. Sometimes it was, some of any fellow got the job, that's the band. That's the way it went, on his name, you see.
